notes.title: The KINESIS Release
notes.notes:
Hello to all of our new fans and welcome to the world of Kinesis! Tomorrow marks our release for the Game so I thought I'd write up our first Community Post, to go along with the release we have a short roadmap of the further development ahead of KINESIS. 

KINESIS as a project has been created and released within the last three months! And we believe that we've created an amazing product in that time. However, there is still a lot more that we want to do in the coming months, and we thought we should let you all know. The full plan is outlined below, but the TLDR is: at least 5 new Levels every 2 weeks! That's a ton of new Content for you guys! 

We here at Cosmic Key hope that you love the Game as much as we do. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39353391/d1f6fd6e63d6e315ebae564ef2868606d15e5249.png[/img]
